stories.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Video Review - IGN
stories.summary: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter reviewed by George Yang on PlayStation 5, also on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Switch 2."There’s never been a better time to get into the Trails series than now. Following the outstanding Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter remake, the Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter remake is just as fantastic. It captures everything that made the original so endearing, and it’s not just a fresh coat of paint. It’s a complete makeover with a polished art style and stellar voice direction that enhance its elegant storytelling and charismatic cast. It also capitalizes on over two decades worth of gameplay iterations and puts them into one action-packed yet emotional adventure. Despite a temporary lull in its penultimate act, that doesn’t stop 2nd Chapter from being a quintessential Trails game and RPG in its own right."
